name: antar-batch-normalization-match-approval
description: Controlled human batch approval for NORMALIZATION_MATCH Verses only. Never auto-approves. Never approves SOURCE_CONFLICT.

frontMatterPolicy.condition: Candidate must define proposedSanskritText as an exact byte copy of the selected PRIMARY_TRANSCRIPTION_CANDIDATE source. Selecting that text retains front matter explicitly; silent strip or rewrite is forbidden.
notes: FRONT_MATTER remains a mandatory human-review category under AUTOMATED_REVIEW_POLICY.md.
Batch eligibility does not invent a front-matter boundary decision beyond retaining the selected source text.
IIT verification absence of front matter is not grounds to strip Wikisource front matter.
PARTIALLY_APPROVED means some Verses are APPROVED while others remain unresolved.
PARTIALLY_APPROVED is not Chapter import-ready and must not imply a complete approved package.
Explicit --apply with named reviewer and decision date is required.
Do not invent, merge, split, reconstruct, or rewrite Sanskrit.
